title: oreophilus dactylus
intro: Oreophilus dactylus, commonly known as the "Tongue Plant" or "Pig's Snout", is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Gesneriaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and its antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Oreophilus dactylus include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
